params.name: start
params.description: Start date for the desired time range

params.name: end
params.description: End date for the desired time range

params.name: format
params.description: Specifies the desired format of the results. Must be either csv or json.

params.name: limit
params.description: Specifies the number of records desired from the backend query. For example, if you specify a limit of 100, you will get the first 100 records for your query, divided up by hour.

params.name: offset
params.description: Specifies the offset at which to apply the limit. With limit, can be used to paginate through a large response. For example, if you specify a limit of 100 and and an offset of 200, you will get the next 100 records starting at the 200th record.
